questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 17 cm and a height of 4 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 17 × 4 = 34 cm². Say the formula before multiplying so you don't forget to halve.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In an open container, why does the measured mass sometimes seem to drop after a reaction?
accept: a gas escapes into the air
questions.why: Mass is actually conserved — but if a gas product escapes into the open air, it leaves the container, so the scale reads less.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is the name for a solid that suddenly forms when two liquids are mixed and react?
questions.why: A precipitate is a solid that appears from a reaction between two solutions — a clear sign a chemical change happened.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: A drink ad shows a famous swimmer celebrating with a sugary sports drink. What technique is this?
questions.why: Using a famous athlete to make a product look desirable is celebrity endorsement — it sells an image, not the drink's actual health value.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: On a nutrition label, which nutrient provides the most energy per gram?
questions.why: Fat provides about 9 calories per gram, more than double protein or carbohydrate — a common mix-up is thinking carbs give the most energy.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: When two substances react and form a new substance, what has actually changed inside them?
questions.why: The atoms rearrange and form new bonds, creating new substances with different properties — the atoms themselves aren't destroyed.

questions.subject: Commerce
questions.prompt: For a bakery's promo video, which task counts as content creation?
questions.why: Content creation means making the actual material people will see or hear, like a script — not admin tasks like bookings or invoices, which just support the video's production.
